title: kraft cloud deploy
description: 'kraft cloud deploy' combines a number of kraft cloud sub-commands to enable you to build, package, ship, and deploy your application with a single command.

build-arg.description: Supply build arguments when building a Dockerfile

build-log.description: Use the specified file to save the output from the build

build-target.description: Supply multi-stage target when building Dockerfile

certificate.description: Set the certificates to use for the service

config.description: Override the path to the KConfig .config file

dbg.description: Build the debuggable (symbolic) kernel image instead of the stripped image

domain.description: Set the domain names for the service

entrypoint.description: Set the entrypoint for the instance

feature.description: Specify the special features to enable

follow.description: Follow the logs of the instance

image.description: Set the image name to use

memory.description: Specify the amount of memory to allocate (MiB increments)

no-cache.description: Force a rebuild even if existing intermediate artifacts already exist

no-configure.description: Do not run Unikraft's configure step before building

no-fast.description: Do not use maximum parallelization when performing the build

no-fetch.description: Do not run Unikraft's fetch step before building

no-start.description: Do not start the instance after creation

no-update.description: Do not update package index before running the build

port.description: Specify the port mapping between external to internal

replicas.description: Number of replicas of the instance

restart.description: Set the restart policy for the instance (never/always/on-failure)

rollout.description: Set the rollout strategy for an instance which has been previously run in the provided service

rollout-qualifier.description: Set the rollout qualifier used to determine which instances should be affected by the strategy in the supplied service

rollout-wait.description: Time to wait before performing rolling out action

rootfs.description: Specify a path to use as root filesystem

scale-to-zero.description: Scale to zero policy of the instance (on/off/idle)

scale-to-zero-cooldown.description: Cooldown period before scaling to zero

scale-to-zero-stateful.description: Save state when scaling to zero

service.description: Attach the new deployment to an existing service

strategy.description: When a package of the same name exists, use this strategy when applying targets

subdomain.description: Set the names to use when provisioning subdomains

timeout.description: Set the timeout for remote procedure calls

vcpus.description: Specify the number of vCPUs to allocate

volume.description: Specify the volume mapping(s) in the form NAME:DEST or NAME:DEST:OPTIONS

editor.description: Set the text editor to open when prompt to edit a file

events-pid-file.description: Events process ID used when running multiple unikernels

http-unix-sock.description: When making HTTP(S) connections, pipe requests via this shared socket

no-emojis.description: Do not use emojis in any console output

no-parallel.description: Do not run internal tasks in parallel

no-prompt.description: Do not prompt for user interaction

no-warn-sudo.description: Do not warn on running via sudo

pager.description: System pager to pipe output to

with-manifest.description: Paths to package or component manifests

with-mirror.description: Paths to mirrors of Unikraft component artifacts
